payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: clippy gate fails on clean base at tests/cli/capture/complete_block_id.rs:292 (manual_contains: ids.iter().any(|id| *id == "dup")); untouched by this phase, reproduces identically on the untouched tree

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: 15 capture CLI tests fail identically on the clean base tree (inbox_route x2, note_pull x3, project_note x3, project_note_offer x6, task_theme_writes x1); verified via stash + full capture:: suite on untouched HEAD

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: lib test wispr_summary_renders_one_or_two_pages_with_stable_words fails identically on the clean base tree; september_shaped_vault_finishes_fast is a load-sensitive timing test that passes in isolation with this phase applied

Grammar phase done and verified. New module capture_language/snooze.rs: lowercase terminal z:<when> lexing (SnoozeIntent { raw, span, drop }), narrow @route:id! drop claim before target validation, shared conflict/teaching messages. TerminalMarkers.snooze and ParsedCaptureText.snooze ride extraction (markers.rs, target_runs crossing-runs incl. Schedule/Priority/Snooze masking, AggregateMarkers with duplicate refusal); multi-target runs refuse; SpanKind::Snooze spans plus incomplete_snooze/invalid_snooze diagnostics keep strict/editor messages byte-identical (bare z, s:/priority/start/close/session/drop conflicts, existing-children, unsupported kinds, drop-vs-toggle). Drop pre-pass (strict item.rs + editor masked view) yields PomodoroLink+drop; caret ^route:id alias shares the exception. Guard at top of plan_capture_item (capture/plan.rs) refuses every recognized intent with snooze_not_yet_executable_error; nothing writes. GRAMMAR_REVISION 31->32 with test assertions updated (docs prose still says 31; completion_docs owns docs-gen/check). FOR MUTATION: consume ParsedCaptureText.snooze — existing-add = PomodoroLink + body empty + snooze.add (route/block set); drop = PomodoroLink + body empty + snooze.drop; new-task = Task/TaskWithBlockId/bare-Pomodoro + body + snooze.add; remove the plan.rs guard only when every accepted intent reaches a planner branch. Verified: 939 lib capture_language tests incl. 8 new snooze tests + snooze.rs unit tests; 5 new CLI tests/cli/capture/parse_snooze.rs; 2066 capture:: CLI pass with only the 15 pre-existing base failures; fmt clean; clippy gate clean for touched files (one pre-existing failure in untouched complete_block_id.rs). Pre-existing failures recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP bead notes.
